units.source_text: 亲王诵经念佛之暇，常常和两女公子戏耍取乐。

en.t: In the intervals between reciting sutras and invoking the Buddha, the prince often amused himself by playing with the two young ladies.

units.source_text: 两女公子渐渐长大，亲王教她们学琴，学棋，做“偏继”游戏。

en.t: As the two young ladies gradually grew older, the prince taught them to play the koto, to play go, and to play the game of hen-tsugi.

units.source_text: 他在细微的游戏中窥察两人的性情。

en.t: Through these small games, he quietly observed the temperaments of the two girls.

units.source_text: 大女公子秉性沉着，思虑深远，态度稳重。

en.t: The elder young lady was calm by nature, deep in thought, and steady in manner.

units.source_text: 二女公子天真烂漫，落落大方，那娇羞之态非常可爱。

en.t: The younger young lady was innocent and bright, open and gracious, and her shy charm was extremely lovely.
Each of the two had her own particular beauty.

units.source_text: 一个日丽风和的春天，池塘里的水鸟比翼偕游，好声和鸣。

en.t: On a fair and gentle spring day, the waterbirds in the pond swam side by side and called to one another in lovely voices.

units.source_text: 若是夫人在日，只当寻常美景。

en.t: If his wife had still been alive, he would have taken it as an ordinary beautiful scene.

units.source_text: 但今日看到这相亲相爱、时刻不离的模样，亲王不胜叹羡，便教两女公子学习弹琴。

en.t: But today, seeing them so affectionate and inseparable, the prince was overcome with wistful admiration and had the two young ladies learn to play the koto.

units.source_text: 娇小可爱的两人，弹出的琴音都很美妙。

en.t: The sounds of the koto played by the two small, lovely girls were both wonderfully beautiful.

units.source_text: 亲王深为感动，泪盈于睫，便赋诗云：

en.t: Deeply moved, the prince’s eyes filled with tears, and he composed a poem, saying:
